title: Required archive resource type proof
verdict: PASS for the stated release type contract

contract.regular_file_semantics: Every required named member must satisfy TarInfo.isfile(); a valid link target does not substitute for a regular member. Ordinary non-required directory entries remain permitted.
contract.archived_python: Inspect archive bytes through JSON and AST parsing without executing archived Python.

preimplementation_proof_designer.scope: Specified contract and adversarial controls before implementation; found 28 unrefused nonregular cases.

postimplementation_reviewer.scope: Separate child actor; did not implement the patch. Read current raw source, earlier proof design and RED/GREEN logs; authored and ran isolated controls.
postimplementation_reviewer.independence_limits: Separate actor and origin, with shared repository and parent context; no claim of blind review, model diversity or authenticated identity.

source_hashes.note: Preserved baseline test file had six tests. RED and GREEN run the expanded seven-test suite; individual RED source bytes are not reconstructed from its workspace receipt.

required_type_matrix.observed: All rejected with ValueError naming the resource as requiring a regular file.

additional_valid_link_target_cases.observed: All rejected, including relative symlink and same-directory hardlink targets containing valid original bytes.

additional_controls: Healthy all-regular archive and ordinary-directory archive accepted.
Future required resource regular member accepted; symlink rejected.
Each of nine missing required resources rejected.

caught_mutations.name: blanket_nonregular_rejection
caught_mutations.counterexample: healthy regular required files plus ordinary directory entries

archived_python_execution_control.payloads: Both archived Python resources contained filesystem-write and raising side effects; diagnostics retained a matching literal TOOL_VERSION.

historical_real_git_archive.head: c34d330a0c194cb49a88a2b8e533d65401d8e765
historical_real_git_archive.scope: Read-only Git archive of that historical HEAD, validated by copied current checker; not a claim about a future HEAD or published package.

nonblocking: Existing release suite lacks a normal-directory positive case; independent controls cover it here.
Existing suite imports REQUIRED, so removing a resource from that set could weaken enumeration; review asserted an independent literal nine-name contract.

binding_limits: Receipt log hashes were verified against actual local logs. Recorded whole-workspace start/end hashes bind endpoints, not a continuous audit of the interval.
Earlier RED workspace was not reconstructed. Preserved baseline hashes and current file hashes are separate observations; the receipt workspace hash alone cannot prove each earlier file revision.
Private harness, archive and log hashes identify observed bytes; private raw paths and logs are omitted. Public source hashes allow comparison but do not authenticate reviewer identity.
scope_limits: No changes to real source, Git, live trials, model processes or global settings; no model or external oracle calls during this review.
TarInfo.isfile() is the bounded acceptance contract, not a general tar extraction or security guarantee.
No exhaustive duplicate, path-normalization, malformed archive, sparse format, archive-bomb or payload-emptiness coverage.
No verification of published artifacts, deployment, live benchmarks or general Confidence Protocol efficacy.
